clusters.headline: Ethiopia Accuses Eritrea and Egypt of Supporting Tigray Rebel Offensive
clusters.summary: On November 14, 2026, Ethiopian military chief Field Marshal Birhanu Jula accused Eritrea of leading a new military offensive against federal forces. Jula alleged that Egypt provided logistical support and weapons to the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) to help overthrow the Ethiopian government. The attacks reportedly targeted military positions across the Amhara and Afar regions. Ethiopian forces claim to have repelled the offensive, forcing TPLF leaders to retreat into Eritrea.
key_facts: Field Marshal Birhanu Jula is the chief of general staff of the Ethiopian National Defense Forces.
The TPLF allegedly launched a fourth round of attacks.
The offensive targeted military positions in the Amhara and Afar regions.
The TPLF is accused of aligning with a group called 'Tsimdo'.
The accusations were made public on November 14, 2026.

clusters.headline: United States supports Egypt's permanent terrorist designation of the Muslim Brotherhood
clusters.summary: The United States has officially commended Egypt for permanently designating the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist organization. Massad Boulos, a senior advisor to President Donald Trump, stated that the move is a critical step in cutting off funding and assets for the group. This decision follows a final court ruling published in Egypt's official gazette. Washington has affirmed its support for Cairo in its efforts to confront the group's alleged violence and destabilization.
key_facts: Massad Boulos serves as the senior advisor to the US President on Arab and African affairs.
The final court ruling was published in Egypt's official gazette on Monday.
Supreme guide Mohamed Badie remains imprisoned on charges related to terrorism and murder.
The Cairo Criminal Court ordered 35 organizations and 36 individuals in Europe to be placed on terrorist lists for five years.
The designation includes freezing assets and cutting off financing for the group.
